For successful completion of the Youth Mental Health training program, demonstrating 
competency in understanding adolescent mental health development, recognizing early 
warning signs in young people, providing age-appropriate support, and connecting youth to 
professional resources. This training covered topics including adolescent brain development, 
common youth mental health challenges and suicide prevention.
